rappel_detail.anchor: natural: a sling around a horn, block or chockstone; no fixed hardware documented
rappel_detail.station: The summit block of the spire.
rappel_detail.notes: One rappel back to the notch the spire rises from; a 30 m rope single-strand or a 60 m rope doubled reaches. Carry cord and a rap ring.

set.rappels: 1 rappel from the summit block to the col, on a 30 m rope single-strand or a 60 m rope doubled
